Subject: Promo credits for Founders First cohort — exception request

Hi Naomi / Ben,

Quick note from our side — we run a summer Founders First cohort (25 early-stage teams) and we budgeted a $10k Redwood starter grant per team. Usage in the pilot cohort is trending ~2.5x higher than expected due to multimodal ingestion work and longer context usage.

Can Redwood consider a one-time promo-credit exception for this cohort — we're asking for $30k in additional free credits (on top of the standard program allocation) plus the option for a 3-month reduced metered rate while the teams ramp. This would help us cover overages during the pilot and keep program retention high.

I've attached the program deck and a short usage snapshot. Happy to jump on a quick 20-minute call if that helps.

Attachments: program-deck.pdf (pptx, 4 slides), usage-snapshot.csv (CSV)

Thanks,
Jamie Carter
Director, Partnerships | Founders First VC
jamie@foundersfirst.vc

Jamie — thanks for the context and the deck. I looked through the snapshot — I can see why consumption spiked.

A few quick questions to help with internal approvals:
- Cohort size (you mentioned ~25) — is that fixed?
- Expected median and 95th percentile monthly token consumption per team for the 3-month window?
- Do any teams handle regulated customer data (PII/PHI) that would require Private deployment?

Ben — looping you in for a pricing/exception path. If we can get usage estimates I can route this for a one-time promo exception + short-term metered discount. Jamie — we can also do a short call tomorrow if you'd prefer.

Best,

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-06-16T08:27:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Promo credits for Founders First cohort — exception request

Thanks Naomi. Jamie — appreciate the deck and the ask. From a commercial standpoint, here's a conservative exception structure we can propose while I take this through approvals:

Proposal (subject to final legal/finance review):
- One-time additional promo credits: $25,000 (applied to account at cohort start)
- Temporary metered discount: 20% off metered rates for 90 days after cohort start for the teams in the program
- Requirement: Commit to quick customer survey at 30/90 days to help us measure program lift (short 5-question form)

I'll attach the internal promo-exception-form for approvals (will need manager sign-off). If that looks reasonable, Naomi — can you confirm program eligibility and any risk flags? Jamie — any preference on how we apply credits (single pool vs. per-team allocation)?

Attachment: promo-exception-form.pdf (stub)

—Ben
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference

Looping in a quick draft of terms to make the exception flow faster. I modeled this as a program-level credit with a per-team advisory allocation in the admin console. Key points:
- Credits applied as a single pool to Founders First master account; admin can allocate to teams manually.
- 90-day 20% metered discount scoped to registered program team API keys.
- Finance notes: invoices will reflect metered usage after discount; credits will be consumed before billing charges.
- Request: 60-day payment terms for any overage invoices (Founders First asked for invoice lag due to partner accounting).

Attached: founders-first-term-sheet-draft.pdf (1 page) — this is intentionally short. If everyone is aligned I can push to legal for a quick SOW addendum and get manager sign-off on the promo-exception-form.
